    'GNI per capita (constant 2015 US dollar)': 'GNI',
    'Adjusted savings: education expenditure (percentage of GNI)': 'Education Expenditure',
    'Exports of goods and services (annual percentage growth)': 'Export Growth',
    'School enrollment, primary (percentage gross)': 'Primary Enrollment',
    'School enrollment, secondary (percentage gross)': 'Secondary Enrollment',

}

    filtered_df = df[df['Series Name'] == series_name]
    # Extract the year columns
    year_columns = [col for col in df.columns if col.startswith('19') or col.startswith('20')]
    # Create a new DataFrame with the year columns and the series name
    year_df = filtered_df[year_columns]
    # Rename the columns to include the series name
    year_df.columns = [f"{col} - {series_name}" for col in year_df.columns]
    # Add the series name as a column
    year_df['Series Name'] = series_name
    # Append to the relevant DataFrame
    df_relevant = pd.concat([df_relevant, year_df], ignore_index=True)

# Drop rows with missing values
df_relevant = df_relevant.dropna()

# Display the first few rows of the relevant DataFrame
df_relevant.head()
